subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): guard assertHttpUrlTargetsPrivateNetwork against malformed URLs

question: Should malformed URL failures from this public SDK helper preserve the native `ERR_INVALID_URL` code while stripping the sensitive parser input?
rationale: The patch changes an observable public plugin API error shape; a compatibility-preserving implementation is available, but the permanent SDK contract remains an owner decision.

options.title: Preserve the error code
options.body: Emit a sanitized TypeError with `code: "ERR_INVALID_URL"` and no `input` or `cause`, preserving common caller classification without retaining secrets.

options.title: Accept the reduced shape
options.body: Keep only TypeError and the stable message, explicitly accepting that plugins relying on the prior error code may need updates.

recommendation.title: Preserve the error code
recommendation.body: Emit a sanitized TypeError with `code: "ERR_INVALID_URL"` and no `input` or `cause`, preserving common caller classification without retaining secrets.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history ties this person to the shared plugin SDK SSRF policy design and adjacent private-network behavior.
